description: What GET /telemetry/collector answers: every router a collector may poll, grouped by building. Built by telemetry (Rust) from its sensors; parsed by ap-collector (Python).

rules.buildings: Only buildings with at least one router in a room. Empty when there are none.
rules.roomId: Always a room: a reading is room-keyed, so an outdoor router is never sent.
rules.driver: Optional. The device model; the collector picks its ubus reader from it (openwrt-iwinfo, else hostapd).
rules.endpoint: Optional. The router's ubus URL on the site network. Absent until someone sets it; a collector may fill it from its own endpointTemplate.
rules.credentials: Never. Router logins stay in the collector's local config; the platform stores addresses only.

cases.name: two buildings, one router without driver or endpoint

rejected.name: an outdoor router
rejected.reason: roomId: must be a room; readings are room-keyed

rejected.name: a building with no router
rejected.reason: routers: a building without one is left out, not listed empty
